description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimuli types. The chart contains seven slices, representing Intra-agency news article (0.7%), Press Release (21.9%), Social Media Post (1.5%), External News Article (13.1%), Organizational Website (6.6%), Interview (10.2%), and Draft/Other (28.5%). The slices are colored yellow, dark green, light green, dark green, light purple, dark blue, and red, respectively. Percentage labels are provided directly within each slice. The segments appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from larger to smaller proportions. The center of the chart is labeled “Stimuli Type”. There is no separate legend provided.
